name: WeatherPoet
zh: Material 3 Expressive 风格的 Android 天气应用：动态主题、动画天气背景、雷达图，Kotlin + Jetpack Compose。
en: A Material 3 Expressive weather app for Android: dynamic theming, animated weather backdrops, radar maps. Kotlin + Jetpack Compose.

name: ClockPoet
zh: Material Expressive 时钟应用：世界时钟、闹钟、计时器，像素级还原现代 Android 设计语言。
en: A Material Expressive clock app: world clock, alarms, timers — modern Android design language done right.

name: WatchPoet
zh: 追剧清单应用：TMDB 数据源，追踪在看 / 待看 / 已看完的剧和电影，Material 3 Expressive UI。
en: A watchlist app for TV shows & movies powered by TMDB — track watching / pending / completed titles. Material 3 Expressive UI.

name: RecordPoet
zh: Material Expressive 录音应用：干净的录音与管理体验，灵感来自 Pixel Recorder。
en: A Material Expressive voice recorder: clean recording & management, inspired by the Pixel Recorder.

name: NotesPoet
zh: Android 笔记应用：富文本格式、标签、导出导入、列表/网格视图切换。
en: A notes app for Android: rich formatting, tags, export/import, list & grid views.

name: MindPoet
zh: 读心术小网页：经典数学把戏的纯前端实现，零依赖，300KB 不到。
en: A tiny mind-reading web toy: the classic math trick in vanilla JS — zero dependencies, under 300 KB.

name: runtimepoet · blog
zh: 你正在看的这个站：Vue 3 + Vite Markdown 博客，毛玻璃 UI，零依赖 Node 后端，单容器 Docker 部署。
en: This very site: a Vue 3 + Vite Markdown blog with a glassmorphism UI, zero-dependency Node backend, single-container Docker deploy.
